messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up 1: Glenwood POC kickoff tomorrow AM. They'll exercise `glenwood-v1-13b` (fp16) and `glenwood-v1-13b-q8` (8-bit quant). Need confirmation both are in catalog and whether any Private/Dedicated compatibility work is required.
Tess: I'll check catalog entries and image matrix. My initial thought: q8 variant uses quant-v3 kernels we shipped last month. Private customers must run runtime image `redwood/runtime:quant-v3-2026-04` otherwise you'll hit fallback to fp16.
Diego: Perf targets from the customer: 110ms p95 @64 tokens, 300ms p95 @512 tokens. KV cache required. Are those achievable on a single A100?
Priya: Billing question from sales: does quant change token billing? Also they asked if cost reductions are automatic or require routing policy changes.
Diego: Token billing unchanged. Quant reduces GPU time per request so effective $/token drops. We can show estimated $/1M tokens for both variants.
Tess: Catalog check: both models present. Added notes: 
- `glenwood-v1-13b` (fp16) id: `glenwood-13b-fp16-v1`
- `glenwood-v1-13b-q8` id: `glenwood-13b-q8-v1`
Caveat: Private must be on runtime `quant-v3` and CUDA >= 12.2. I'll paste matrix: https://intra.redwood.dev/catalog/glenwood (internal)
Sam: Security/Legal flagged: they want CMK support, SOC2 attestation, ability to restrict logs to customer tenant. Also a short questionnaire asking about key custody and audit retention windows.
Priya: I'll draft answers. Short: CMK via KMS/HSM supported, SOC2 report available, logs per-tenant retention configurable (default 90d, enterprise 13mo). Air-gapped/FIPS support? We offer Private on-prem with FIPS build as professional services.
Diego: For Dedicated (Redwood-managed A100 pool) both variants are fine. For Private (customer infra) ops checklist:
```
- Ensure CUDA >=12.2
- runtime image: redwood/runtime:quant-v3-2026-04
- start with --enable-quant-kernel-v3 flag
- enable kv-cache and set kv_max_size: 8GB
```
Sam: Customer also asked about warm KV cache behavior after restarts (session affinity). Any known gotchas with q8?
Diego: q8 kernel can delay KV snapshot restore slightly (<200ms) because of quant conversion path in older infra. New runtime includes fast-restore path. Note that if they use very large keys (>16M tokens) we should warn about memory pressure.
Tess: Pricing options I'll draft: Hosted eval (pay-as-you-go), Dedicated reserved (2x A100 baseline estimate), Private (license + support). Ballpark: Dedicated commit ~ $40k/month for baseline throughput; q8 may reduce committed capacity by ~25% depending on concurrency.
Priya: Legal note: they requested a DPA + encryption addendum before we ingest any customer data on Hosted. Also asked for an NDA to review model artifacts.
Sam: Timeline: need staging endpoints + creds by EOD today for smoke tests. Can we get a Hosted staging URL and a Dedicated staging allocation?
Tess: Hosted staging: provisioning now. I'll post link when ready. Dedicated staging requires infra slot; opening a request to infra with priority P1.
ci-bot: Hosted staging endpoint provisioned: https://staging.redwood.dev/glenwood-poc-2026-04 - token link sent to Sam via secure share.
Sam: Great. Diego can you run a quick benchmark and post numbers? Use seq 64 and 512, kv on.
Diego: Quick bench run (local):
```bash
./perf_test --model glenwood-13b-q8-v1 --seq 512 --batch 2 --kv on --runtime quant-v3
# Result: p95=285ms, p50=120ms, gpu_util=78%
```
Diego: fp16 baseline on same infra: p95=100ms @64, p95=250ms @512. q8 slightly higher latency at small seq but better throughput and ~22% GPU cost reduction for sustained load.
Priya: I uploaded draft security answers to the sales drive and tagged legal. Also adding note about FIPS build lead time (2-3 weeks + PS).
Tess: Catalog and infra notes done. Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.dev/glenwood-poc-2026-04 (same as CI bot). Dedicated infra ticket #INF-9342 created.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Tess to share exact image tag and infra ticket; Diego to share full CSV perf results; Priya to finalize security Qs and DPA checklist; I'll consolidate and send kickoff email. Ping here for blockers. :pray:
